campaigns.name: Ransomware Readiness for Burlington SMEs
campaigns.audience: Manufacturing, logistics, construction, and property management
campaigns.core_message: Backups are not evidence of recovery until restoration has been tested.
blockers: No ClearGlass SKU tests backup restoration. The Quick-Audit and Hardening Sprint pages do not mention backup or recovery testing, so the CTA 'Test your recovery readiness' has nothing to sell. Price a restore-test engagement (a governed price-book change) or re-scope the campaign to an existing offer.
